title: Introduce a structured logger (replace console.error, add server-fn error logging)
description: Recurring 'no logger yet' gap flagged across reviews: src/db/client.ts pool 'error' handler console.error dumps the full pg client object (noisy in e2e output); P1 review flagged server-function handlers log nothing and env-validation errors lack context. Add a small structured logger, replace the console.error in db/client with logged error.message, and add log-and-rethrow at the server-fn boundary for observability.
design: Logger library: pino + pino-pretty (chosen after sweeping pino/winston/bunyan/roarr/tslog/consola/evlog/morgan/log4js — pino is the most-adopted in-category structured JSON logger, fastest, with child() context + redact). Shape: server-only src/lib/logger.ts; JSON to stdout in prod (Coolify/container aggregation), pino-pretty transport in dev; redact configured for token/secret fields (e.g. authorization, CF_EMAIL_TOKEN, invite codes). Scope: (1) the logger module; (2) replace db/client pool 'error' console.error with logger.error(err.message ...); (3) log-and-rethrow at the server-fn boundary. This is the base layer; wide-events/canonical-log-line request middleware is a separate follow-up that builds on it.
notes: Re-scope (per spec-conformance review): design item (3) 'log-and-rethrow at the server-fn boundary' is NOT in this bead — it lands in gf-fwi.13 (minimal error-logging request middleware, the production observability baseline), which gf-fwi.12 then extends into wide-events. This bead delivers (1) the pino logger module + (2) the db/client pool-error replacement only. Note: db/client logs the whole error via pino's {err} serializer ({type,message,stack,code}), richer than the literal 'error.message' the description names — captures pg error codes (ECONNRESET, 57P01) that message alone drops.
close_reason: Structured pino logger delivered: src/lib/logger.ts (prod JSON / dev pino-pretty tree-shaken from prod bundle, redact for secret fields, LOG_LEVEL from process.env with allow-list validation + warn-on-invalid). db/client pool-error handler now logs via pino's {err} serializer (captures error.code) instead of console.error. resolveLevel unit-tested. Design item (3) server-fn boundary logging re-scoped to gf-fwi.13 (prod-gated). Reviewed 2 iterations (codex + 3 agents clean); 53 tests + typecheck/lint/build green.

title: Server-fn/request error-logging middleware (observability baseline)
description: gf-fwi.10 added the pino logger, but nothing logs server-fn/request errors yet: a thrown server function leaves no structured, contextual log line (only Nitro's default stderr). Add the minimal global request middleware that catches errors from Start-handled requests (serverFn + router), logs them via the logger with request context, and rethrows. This is the production observability baseline — do not deploy to prod without server-error logging. NOT the full wide-events model (gf-fwi.12 extends this).
design: Add the Start instance (no src/start.ts yet) and register a global request middleware via createStart({ requestMiddleware: [errorLog] }). errorLog = createMiddleware({type:'request'}).server(async ({ request, pathname, next, handlerType, serverFnMeta }) => try { return await next() } catch (err) { logger.error({ err, method, pathname, handlerType, fn: serverFnMeta?.name }, 'request error'); throw err }). Uses pino's {err} serializer (captures error.code). This is the SAME middleware gf-fwi.12 extends into wide-events (ALS field accumulation + one canonical log line per request + reqId from cf-ray) — foundation here, ambitious layer there. Refs installed @tanstack/start-client-core 1.170 createMiddleware (request type; handlerType serverFn|router; registered via createStart requestMiddleware).
close_reason: Error-logging request middleware delivered: src/start.ts (Start instance + global errorLogger request middleware logging THROWN server-fn/router errors via dynamically-imported pino then rethrow; CSRF re-added since defining start.ts disables Start's auto server-fn CSRF). handle-request-error.ts (log-and-rethrow helper, logger injected for client-safety) + is-loggable-error.ts (skips redirect/notFound control flow + sub-5xx Responses), both unit-tested. 5xx-Response-RESULT logging deferred to gf-fwi.12 (owns it, trigger note added). Reviewed 2 iterations (codex + 5 agents, all converged); 58 tests + typecheck/lint/build green; client bundle verified pino-free.

title: Wire React Aria Components navigation to TanStack Router
description: Intent UI components are React Aria Components; their href-based navigation (Link, Menu items, Tabs, Breadcrumbs, Card-as-link) does NOT route through TanStack Router until wired. Nothing is wired yet (no RouterProvider, no createLink, no link.tsx). Needed before any navigation-heavy feature UI is built.
design: (1) Mount React Aria's RouterProvider (from react-aria-components) at the app root (src/router.tsx / __root) wiring navigate -> TanStack Router navigate and useHref -> the router's href builder, so every RAC component with href routes client-side. (2) Add a typed Link via createLink (@tanstack/react-router) wrapping RAC's Link for type-safe to/params/search. (3) Add src/components/ui/link.tsx (Intent UI Link) through that typed createLink. Refs: Intent UI client-side-routing doc (intentui.com/docs/getting-started/client-side-routing); React Aria RouterProvider docs. Note RAC RouterProvider needs the router's navigate signature; TanStack Router exposes it via the router instance.

title: Wide-events request middleware (canonical log lines over pino)
description: Observability layer on top of the pino base logger (gf-fwi.10): emit ONE wide, structured 'canonical log line' per request instead of scattered log calls. Grounded in installed @tanstack/start-client-core 1.170 createMiddleware API.
design: Mechanism (verified against installed 1.170 source): use a REQUEST middleware — createMiddleware({type:'request'}).server(async ({request, pathname, next, handlerType, serverFnMeta}) => ...) — registered GLOBALLY via createStart({ requestMiddleware: [loggingMiddleware] }). Key facts: (1) request middleware fires for handlerType 'serverFn' AND 'router' (page/SSR), so one middleware covers both the server-fn data path and page loads — no separate Nitro hook needed for basic coverage. (2) Inputs for fields: raw web Request (method/headers/url), pathname, handlerType, serverFnMeta (fn name when a server fn). The middleware result exposes response (status). (3) Context: next({context:{log, reqId}}) injects the request-scoped pino child into server-fn context (typed via GlobalServerRequestContext); ALSO wrap next() in AsyncLocalStorage.run({log, fields}, ...) so services/db deep in the stack append fields without prop-drilling. (4) In a finally after next(), emit logger.info({reqId, handlerType, method, pathname, fn, status, durationMs, ...fields}, 'request'). (5) reqId sourcing: prefer an inbound correlation header, else generate — reqId = request.headers.get('cf-ray') ?? request.headers.get('x-request-id') ?? crypto.randomUUID(). Reusing Cloudflare's cf-ray correlates app logs with CF edge logs (the app is CF-fronted); crypto.randomUUID is zero-dep (ULID/nanoid only if time-sortable ids are later wanted). Prereq: project has NO Start instance yet (no src/start.ts) — this bead must add createStart + register the global request middleware. NOT pino-http (that's Node req/res; Start uses web Request/Response) — hand-roll with a pino child.
notes: Builds on gf-fwi.13: the Start instance + global request middleware + minimal error logging are established there; THIS bead extends that same middleware into the full wide-events model (AsyncLocalStorage field accumulation + one canonical log line per request + reqId from cf-ray/x-request-id). OWNS 5xx-response logging: gf-fwi.13 logs THROWN errors, but Start's executeMiddleware resolves returned/thrown Responses (incl. 5xx) into next()'s result rather than throwing, so they bypass gf-fwi.13's catch (codex flagged this). gf-fwi.12 logs status per request, capturing those 5xx outcomes — do it here (not gf-fwi.13) to avoid double-logging. TRIGGER to promote to a pre-prod gate (make gf-fwi.4 depend on this): once server routes (createFileRoute server handlers) that RETURN Responses exist, the 5xx-Response gap becomes real and observability is incomplete without this. Until then, the app is server-fn-only and every failure is a thrown error that gf-fwi.13 already logs, so this stays a P3 enhancement, not a deploy gate. Coverage caveat: truly raw Nitro routes outside Start bypass request middleware; negligible for this app.
close_reason: Wide-events canonical-log-line middleware delivered: one structured 'request' line per request (reqId from cf-ray/x-request-id/uuid, pino child, method/path/handlerType/fn/status/durationMs + ALS-accumulated fields). emitRequestLog self-guarding (logging never changes request outcome); runInstrumented lifecycle extracted + unit-tested; request-context ALS (addRequestFields/getRequestLog). Owns 5xx-response logging (gf-fwi.13 gap). Replaced handle-request-error. Reviewed 2 iterations + post-loop + extraction re-review (codex + agents, all clean); 72 tests + build green, client bundle clean; smoke-verified end-to-end (router GET / -> one INFO line). Follow-ups: gf-fwi.14, gf-fwi.15.
